title: Auto Redirect component schema
description: Countdown + Skip/Continue control block. `time` is seconds before auto-redirecting (0/omitted = no auto-redirect, Skip only — visible alongside the countdown either way). `type`/`link` mirror the button component's shape (url|page|qr): for `qr`, the frontend resolves the target QR's own public URL once at edit time (qr/minimal/'s short_url) and stores it in `link`, so at render time `qr` is handled identically to `url` — no separate backend resolution needed. `qrTarget` is display-only (lets the builder re-show which QR is currently selected) and carries no redirect meaning of its own.
